additions.name: Ruti
additions.note: Women's clothing boutique from Israel, open in Town & Country Village since November 2009. The store is still listed at 855 El Camino Real #45.

additions.name: Sweet 55
additions.note: Swiss chocolate shop at Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported a June 17, 2022 grand opening for the Palo Alto store at 855 El Camino Real Suite 123, and a November 2026 Peninsula shopping guide still lists SWEET55 at Town & Country Village.

additions.name: Coyuchi
additions.note: Organic bedding and home-goods store at Town & Country Village, opened in November 2022. A current listing still places it at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 5.

additions.name: Sushi House
additions.note: Japanese restaurant in Town & Country Village. A current Palo Alto directory lists Sushi House at 855 El Camino Real Suite 158 and dates it to 1988 at the same address; a 2015 student restaurant guide also says it opened in 1988.

additions.name: The Penny Ice Creamery
additions.note: Ice cream shop in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported in February 2023 that The Penny Ice Creamery was expected to open that April at 855 El Camino Real #121, and its August 2023 ice-cream guide listed the Palo Alto shop operating there; the creamery's site still lists Palo Alto hours.

additions.name: Gott's Roadside
additions.note: Burger restaurant in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online's October 11, 2013 Shop Talk said Gott's Roadside had opened the previous month in Town & Country Village; a current Palo Alto directory lists it at 855 El Camino Real Suite 65 and says it has served there since 2013.

additions.name: Oren’s Hummus Express
additions.note: Quick-service Israeli restaurant in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported the prototype Oren’s Hummus Express would open May 8, 2019 at Town & Country Village Suite 162; a current Palo Alto directory still lists the Express at 855 El Camino Real Suite 162 as a separate location.

additions.name: Poke House
additions.note: Poke restaurant in Town & Country Village that replaced pokéLOVE. Palo Alto Online reported it soft-opened in January 2019 and held a grand opening on January 27, 2019.

additions.name: Serena & Lily
additions.note: Home furnishings design shop at Town & Country Village that opened November 11, 2023. Its about 3,200-square-foot showroom sells furniture, bedding and home accessories.

additions.name: Marine Layer
additions.note: Casual clothing store at Town & Country Village that opened in 2015 and doubled to about 1,800 square feet in December 2022. A current Palo Alto shopping guide still lists it in Building 1 of the center.

additions.name: Manresa Bread
additions.note: Bakery in Town & Country Village that opened April 15, 2022 in a space of about 1,700 square feet at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 138. A current Palo Alto visitor guide still lists it there, open daily.

additions.name: Boba Guys
additions.note: Milk tea shop in Town & Country Village that soft-opened January 8, 2019, with a grand opening planned for February 2. Palo Alto Weekly's Best of 2026 still lists it at 855 El Camino Real #120.

additions.name: Wildseed
additions.note: Plant-based restaurant from San Francisco that opened its second location at Town & Country Village on March 10, 2022, in the former Mayfield Bakery space. Its reservation listing still shows it operating at 855 El Camino Real.

additions.name: Boichik Bagels
additions.note: New York-style bagel shop that opened its Palo Alto outpost at Town & Country Village in November 2022, between CVS and Wildseed. A current Palo Alto visitor guide still lists it there, open daily.

additions.name: Antoine's Cookie Shop
additions.note: Cookie shop from San Mateo that opened its second location at Town & Country Village on January 15, 2021, in the former Babka by Ayelet space. The center's directory still lists it in Building 1, Suite 15.

additions.name: Roost & Roast
additions.note: Thai-inspired chicken restaurant at Town and Country Village that opened in Palo Alto in June 2021 at 855 El Camino Real. A Palo Alto guide published in October 2026 still lists Roost and Roast operating there.

additions.name: Palmetto Superfoods
additions.note: Açaí bowl and smoothie shop at Town & Country Village that opened in April 2023. The center's directory still lists it in Building 5, Suite 160.

additions.name: Hudson Grace
additions.note: Home decor and entertaining shop at Town & Country Village selling ceramics, serveware, candles and linens. A March 2015 building-permit listing shows a tenant improvement for Hudson Grace in Suite 135 at 855 El Camino Real, and the store remains open there.

additions.name: El Merkat
additions.note: Spanish market attached to Telefèric Barcelona at Town & Country Village, selling imported Spanish foods such as cheeses, cured meats and olive oils. It opened with the restaurant in October 2019 at Suite 130, and a current Spanish-foods directory still lists it there.

additions.name: Trader Joe's
additions.note: Grocery store at Town & Country Village that opened December 4, 2009, after years of requests from Palo Alto residents. The center's directory still lists it among its food tenants.

additions.name: Calafia Cafe
additions.note: Restaurant started by former Google chef Charlie Ayers, with an adjoining takeout shop called Market a-Go-Go, on the Embarcadero Road side of Town & Country Village. It opened in January 2009 and closed in August 2018 after about nine years.

additions.name: Village Cheese House
additions.note: Deli at Town & Country Village from 1959, known for its housemade spreads, imported cheeses and large sandwiches. It closed on December 31, 2019, after about six decades.

additions.name: Howie's Artisan Pizza
additions.note: Pizza restaurant at Town & Country Village opened in November 2009 by chef Howard Bulka, serving hand-tossed pizza, handmade pasta and focaccia sandwiches. A current Palo Alto visitor guide still lists it there, open daily.

additions.name: Asian Box
additions.note: Fast-casual counter at Town & Country Village serving customizable gluten-free Vietnamese-style boxes with rice, noodles, salads and proteins. It opened in March 2012 and remains open.

additions.name: Tava Kitchen
additions.note: Fast-casual Indian restaurant at the back of Town & Country Village. It opened in February 2012 as Tava Indian Kitchen, was renamed Tava Kitchen in 2016, and closed on January 16, 2017 when its five-year lease ended.

additions.name: Bryn Walker
additions.note: Women's clothing boutique that moved here in 2015, after 17 years at 515 Cowper St., into the restored 1907 Thompson's Bakery building. It closed on Feb. 2, 2020.

additions.name: Ambassador Toys
additions.note: Toy store at Town & Country Village, a branch of a San Francisco toy business founded in 1997, that opened in Palo Alto in 2008. Palo Alto Online reported in early 2020 that it was closing as its owner retired.

additions.name: Halo Blow Dry Bar
additions.note: Blow-dry salon that opened at Town & Country Village around 2010 as the chain's first location. It moved from a small space facing Embarcadero Road into the center's interior in late 2012 and closed on December 31, 2017.

additions.name: Korean BBQ
additions.note: Small family-owned Korean restaurant in Town & Country Village, popular for lunch. It opened in 1991 and closed in August 2012 after years on a month-to-month lease.

additions.name: CVS Pharmacy
additions.note: Drugstore in Town & Country Village that took over the Longs Drugs store after CVS bought the Longs chain, and was listed as CVS/pharmacy at 855 El Camino Real by August 2009. CVS still lists a store at this address.

additions.name: Peet's Coffee
additions.note: Palo Alto Online called Peet's a newer Town and Country development in June 2001, the first source showing it there; Peet's still lists its Town & Country store at 855 El Camino Real.

additions.name: Telefèric Barcelona
additions.note: Spanish tapas restaurant from Barcelona that opened for dinner at Town & Country Village on October 8, 2019, in Suite 130, the former Calafia Cafe space. The restaurant's website still lists hours for its Palo Alto location.

additions.name: Douce France
additions.note: French bakery at Town & Country Village that opened in 1981; Palo Alto Online's Best Of confirms the Town and Country address.

additions.name: Kara's Cupcakes
additions.note: Cupcake bakery at Town & Country Village that opened in September 2008. Listings still place it at 855 El Camino Real Suite 50.

additions.name: Mamahuhu
additions.note: Fast-casual Chinese-American restaurant from the founders of San Francisco's Mister Jiu's, which opened in Town & Country Village in fall 2025 at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 75. The restaurant's own site still lists the Palo Alto location.

additions.name: bluemercury
additions.note: Beauty retailer described as recently opened at Town & Country Village in June 2022; Palo Alto Online Best of 2025 still lists it there.

additions.name: 18 | 8 Fine Men’s Salons
additions.note: Men's salon that opened at Town & Country Village on February 10, 2018; its Palo Alto page still lists 855 El Camino Real.

additions.name: The UPS Store
additions.note: Shipping, printing and mailbox center in Town & Country Village. Current listings place store #6105 at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 13A, but its opening year has not been confirmed.

additions.name: Pact
additions.note: Organic cotton clothing shop at Town & Country Village. It opened in December 2022 as the brand's second Bay Area store.

additions.name: Sprout San Francisco
additions.note: Palo Alto branch of a San Francisco children's boutique selling natural and organic baby clothing, toys and gear, in Town & Country Village around 2018. Business listings now mark the store closed, and the exact closing date is unknown.

additions.name: Marigold Row
additions.note: Women's clothing store at Town & Country Village selling handcrafted natural-fabric pieces that blend Indian craft with Western styling. It was one of four new stores announced in December 2023, and the center's directory still lists it.

additions.name: Howard's Shoes for Children
additions.note: Family-run children's shoe store, founded in 1962, that moved from Stanford Shopping Center to Town & Country Village and held its grand opening there on April 1, 2019. Recent listings still place it at the center.

additions.name: Fillmore & 5th
additions.note: Secondhand fashion shop at Town & Country Village whose opening dates to 2012; still listed there in 2026.

additions.name: Jamba
additions.note: Smoothie and juice shop at Town & Country Village. It was first called Juice Club, was damaged in a June 1996 fire that started at the neighboring Hobee's, and reopened as Jamba Juice in April 1997; current listings still place it at Suite 85.

additions.name: Tennis Town & Country
additions.note: Family-run tennis shop at Town & Country Village that opened October 2, 2009. It sells rackets, apparel and shoes and offers racket stringing.

additions.name: Wilby Optical
additions.note: Eyewear shop at Town & Country Village, founded in 1957 and now at Suite 103. In January 2025 the luxury eyewear brand Alexander Daas acquired it and renamed it Wilby Optical by Alexander Daas.

additions.name: Chase
additions.note: Chase bank branch at Town & Country Village, the bank's fourth in Palo Alto, which FDIC records date to April 2, 2014. Branch directories still list it in Building 2, Suite 67.

additions.name: Books Inc
additions.note: Independent bookstore that moved from Stanford Shopping Center and opened its Town & Country Village store on February 1, 2008, in a space of about 4,000 square feet. It is still listed at the center, in unit 74.

additions.name: For Eyes
additions.note: Optical shop selling eyeglasses and offering eye exams at Town & Country Village, Suite 83. Palo Alto Weekly named it a Best Of winner for eyewear in 2006, and the center's directory still lists it.

additions.name: Diptyque
additions.note: Boutique of the Paris fragrance and candle house in Town & Country Village. The brand's store locator and the center's directory list it at 855 El Camino Real, Building 2, Suite 34.

additions.name: LaBelle Day Spa & Salon
additions.note: Day spa and hair salon at Town & Country Village, part of a Bay Area chain founded in 1976. Palo Alto Online's Best Of lists named it in 2005 and 2013, and the center's directory still lists it in Building 2, offering hair, skin, nail and medspa services.

additions.name: J. McLaughlin
additions.note: Clothing boutique at Town & Country Village, scheduled to open June 13, 2014 in the former Crimson Mim space. A current directory listing still places it at 855 El Camino Real.

additions.name: Faherty
additions.note: Clothing shop at Town & Country Village that opened February 24, 2023.

additions.name: Athleta
additions.note: Women's athletic apparel store in Town & Country Village, hosting race events there by July 2013. Athleta's store locator still lists it at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 37.

additions.name: Evereve
additions.note: Women's clothing shop that opened at Town & Country Village in March 2023, next to Athleta.

additions.name: Margaret O'Leary
additions.note: Knitwear and clothing boutique from the Bay Area designer, opened at Town & Country Village in April 2015 in a space that once held a cobbler. The center's directory still lists it in Building 2, Suite 43, next to Ruti.

additions.name: Lulu's
additions.note: Mexican taqueria run by a local family, a branch of Lulu's in Menlo Park. It signed for a space next to Kara's Cupcakes in late 2008, was serving by 2009, and the restaurant still lists this location at 855 El Camino Real #49.

additions.name: Paper Source
additions.note: Stationery and paper-goods shop in Town & Country Village at 855 El Camino Real #63, opened in 2009. Palo Alto Online's 2009 Best Of named it the year's best new retail business.

additions.name: Opportunity Center
additions.note: A five-story drop-in services and supportive housing center that opened in September 2006. LifeMoves runs drop-in services here, including food, clothing, laundry, showers and case management.

additions.name: Pizzeria Delfina
additions.note: Palo Alto branch of a San Francisco Neapolitan-style pizzeria. It opened in April 2014 in the former Empire Grill and Tap Room space and is still open.

additions.name: Tacolicious
additions.note: Mexican taqueria and bar, an outpost of a small San Francisco chain, that opened in February 2013 in the former Mantra space. It closed after its last service on October 31, 2025.

additions.name: Dan Gordon's
additions.note: Brewpub and barbecue restaurant on Emerson Street in the original Gordon Biersch space. It reopened under this name in March 2016 after a renovation and closed permanently in March 2020.

additions.name: Mayfield Bakery & Cafe
additions.note: Bakery and restaurant at Town & Country Village opened in 2009 by Bacchus Management Group, the owners of the Village Pub. It closed permanently in late July 2020 amid the pandemic, and Wildseed later took over its large corner space.

additions.name: Hobee's California Restaurant
additions.note: Location of a local restaurant chain known for its blueberry coffee cake, open at Town & Country Village from 1984. It closed in January 2013 after lease talks tied to the center's renovation, and Gott's Roadside later moved into its building.

additions.name: Kirk's Steakburgers
additions.note: Burger restaurant that moved to Town and Country Village around 2002 after losing its lease on California Avenue. Under new owners, it left in September 2024 for a larger space at 2680 Middlefield Road in Midtown.

additions.name: Honeys and Heroes
additions.note: Children's boutique that opened in early November 2007 in a corner space next to Long's Drugs at Town & Country Village. Its closing date is not known.

additions.name: Cook Book Restaurant
additions.note: Breakfast and lunch restaurant at the back of Town & Country Village that opened in 1980. It closed on July 31, 2005, after the center's new owners ended its month-to-month lease, which set off a community outcry.

additions.name: Scott's Seafood
additions.note: Seafood restaurant that opened at Town and Country Village in February 2002 in the former Stickney's space. It closed on March 8, 2015.

additions.name: Longs Drugs
additions.note: Drugstore that took over the former John's Market space of about 14,000 square feet at Town & Country Village around 2002. It was still operating in 2007 and later became a CVS after CVS bought the Longs chain in 2008.

additions.name: Ole's Car Shop
additions.note: Auto repair shop on Alma Street at Homer Avenue, run by its owner for about 23 years until he retired in 2008. The site was then sold for an affordable-housing development with ground-floor retail.

additions.name: Stickney's Hick'ry House
additions.note: Long-running family restaurant at the north corner of Town & Country Village, also known as Stickney's Family Restaurant. A 1994 review said it had served locals for more than 40 years, and local recollections say it closed around 1999–2000.

additions.name: Garner's Pro Bicycle Shop
additions.note: Bicycle shop in Town & Country Village that moved there from Alma Plaza in the mid-1990s and reopened after a fire in October 1996. It closed in late May 2002, while its Redwood City store stayed open.

additions.name: Union Auto Repair
additions.note: Family-run auto repair shop on Alma Street near Addison Avenue, started in the early 1950s by Hank Barnes Sr. and later run by his son. It closed around 2000.

additions.name: House of Faith Recording Studio
additions.note: Low-cost recording studio on Urban Lane that recorded hundreds of local punk and underground bands in the early 1990s. It opened in 1990 and closed in May 1994 after the lot was bought for medical redevelopment.

additions.name: Petaluma's Rotisserie
additions.note: Family-friendly rotisserie at No. 73 Town & Country Village serving spit-roasted chicken and homey side dishes. It was reviewed in January 1992 and was still open in August 1996, after a nearby fire hurt its sales.

fields.note: Hair salon listed at 933 Emerson St in a 2009 Best of Silicon Valley readers' poll and still open today. It may have opened before 2009.

Dairy store and grill serving breakfast, lunch, ice cream and milkshakes. The family-run Peninsula Creamery opened this store at High and Channing in 1970, in a former auto dealership, and it is still open.

Antique shop at the corner of Addison Ave and Alma St, run by former antique dealers and selling furniture and collectibles. It opened in July 2005 and closed in June 2015, and was described as Palo Alto's last antique store.
Family-owned hardware store selling tools, garden and home supplies, opened in 1993 as Palo Alto Hardware and still open today as Hassett ACE Hardware.
Small grocery at 949 Emerson St, earlier known as SOS Grocery and named in local news by 2015. Its exact opening year is not known.
